headline: Tabled McDevitt School Civic Project Resolution; approved minutes and requested gas main info from Nationalgrid
summary: The committee approved meeting minutes from June 15 and June 22, 2026. It tabled a resolution on the McDevitt School Civic Project, took 17-80s and private-to-public ways off the table, requested gas main location and repair information from Nationalgrid for Mt Pleasant and Buxton, and then tabled all matters again.
decisions: Approved the meeting minutes from 6/15/2026 by voice vote.
Approved the meeting minutes from 6/22/2026 by voice vote.
Tabled the Resolution for McDevitt School Civic Project Resolution by voice vote.
Took all the 17-80s and private-to-public ways collectively off the table by voice vote.
Approved a request to have Nationalgrid provide the location of gas mains on Mt Pleasant and Buxton and when they are to be repaired or replaced.
Tabled all matters collectively by voice vote.

plain_text:
Public Works and Public Safety Committee
Meeting Minutes
August 3, 2026
The Chair called the meeting to order at 10:34 p.m. 
The Clerk called the roll.
Present: Councillors Dunn, Katz, King, LaFauci, Tzioumis.
Absent: None.
Councillor LaFauci moved approval of the meeting minutes from 6/15/2026. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote.
Councillor LaFauci moved approval of the meeting minutes from 6/22/2026. The motion was 
approved by a voice vote.
First agenda item: Resolution for McDevitt School Civic Project Resolution
Councillor Katz tabled the matter. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
Councillor LaFauci moved to take all the 17-80s and private-to-public ways collectively off of the
table. The motion was approved by a voice vote. Assistant Solicitor Learned was present and 
went over the status of all the projects. 
Councillor LaFauci made a request that was approved by a voice vote to have the gas company, 
Nationalgrid give us the location of gas mains on Mt Pleasant and Buxton and when they are to be
repaired/replaced. Councillor King asked who notifies the owners of needing more signatures. 
Assistant Solicitor Learned stated the ward Councillors usually communicate with the residents. 
Councillor LaFauci stated he has already been in communication with his constituents. 
Councillor Logan spoke on Duddy Ave.
Councillor LaFauci moved to table all matters collectively. The motion was approved by a voice 
vote. 
With no further matters Councillor LaFauci moved to adjourn.
Chairwoman Dunn declared the meeting adjourned at 9:34 p.m.
Respectfully submitted,
Kara Wilson, Assistant City Clerk
June 23, 2026
